messages:
Maria: deploybot preflight flagged a prompt-eval regression on canary for tonight's change window. delta=+3.5% (threshold 2%). canary promotion halted.

deploybot: [automated] preflight-eval: FAILED. metric=prompt_quality delta=+3.5% > threshold(2%). promotion_paused=true.

Ken: Okay, which PR triggered this?

Maria: PR #8423 from Joel modified token trimming heuristics for long prompts. QA ran a small sweep during staging and saw degradation.

Joel: That was me. I added trimming to reduce average sequence length and lower latency. Locally I saw minor change but not this size.

Emma: @Joel can you share the exact change? Is it possible we mis-sampled the prompt set?

Joel: Patch is small, two files: tokenizer/utils.py and runtime/trim.py. I can open a revert PR if needed.

Raj: Ops note: deploybot blocks automatically. Manual override is possible but requires eng + qa + product signoff and a risk justification. We can also pin traffic, but this release uses a single model variant across regions.

Sara: Important: exemption requires RCA of why the eval delta happened and mitigations. We prefer revert for accuracy regressions.

Priya: Product perspective: summarization accuracy is critical. Not OK to ship with +3.5% degradation. Recommend rollback or revert immediately.

Joel: I can revert the token-trimming commit. Estimate ~25-40 minutes to PR -> merge -> new canary. If we revert, can QA run a focused sample?

Emma: QA can run quick sweep n=250 covering long/short bins within 30 minutes of a new canary. We can also do a targeted hallucination metric sweep.

Maria: Action proposal: 1) Joel pushes revert PR 2) Merge -> new canary 3) Re-run deploybot preflight + QA sweep 4) If pass, continue change window 5) Track a follow-up ticket to reintroduce change behind a feature flag and tighter evals.

deploybot: action logged: TICKET-1124 created to track revert + re-eval. Suggestion: rollback_method=revert-PR.

Raj: I'll monitor canary metrics and hold the release window until QA signoff.

Joel: Revert PR opened and merged -> new canary build at 1748209130. Triggering `deploybot preflight re-run`.

deploybot: preflight started for build 1748209130...

deploybot: preflight result: PASS. metric=prompt_quality delta=+0.2% (within threshold).

Emma: QA sweep complete (n=250, stratified). No statistically significant regressions. Hallucination and factuality metrics stable.

Priya: Product approves resuming the change window with revert in place. We'll require the rework to be behind a feature flag with additional prompt-eval gating before future rollouts.

Maria: I'll update release notes to reflect the revert: "reverted token trimming change due to summarization regression; optimization will be re-implemented behind feature flag after further evaluation." Also adding a short customer-facing blurb if needed.

Ken: Should we add an internal postmortem note to summarize sampling differences and guardrails?

Sara: Yes, please add a brief postmortem and include the eval suite that caught it. That helps QA and model owners tune thresholds.

Maria: Thanks all. Closing the loop and marking TICKET-1124 resolved after final checks. :white_check_mark:
